theme.title: Wilt's impossible season
theme.subtitle: Philadelphia Warriors, 1961–62
theme.recap: Wilt Chamberlain averaged 50.4 points, scored 100 in one night in front of a small crowd and barely left the floor all season.

questions.prompt: How many points did Wilt Chamberlain score against the Knicks on March 2, 1962?
questions.context: Philadelphia Warriors vs New York Knicks · 1961–62

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: by scoring 100 points for the Philadelphia Warriors in a 169–147 win over the New York Knicks on March 2, 1962

funFacts.text: This famous Philadelphia Warriors home game was actually staged in Hershey, Pennsylvania, in an arena originally built for ice hockey.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game was played at Hershey Sports Arena, an old, drafty gym originally built for ice hockey.

funFacts.text: Only audio of the fourth quarter survives, and the recording was added to the U.S. National Recording Registry.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: there are only audio recordings of the game's fourth quarter, which was added for preservation in the United States' National Recording Registry

funFacts.text: In the fourth quarter, the Knicks deliberately fouled other Warriors to keep the ball away from Wilt. The Warriors started fouling back to regain possession.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: During the fourth quarter, the Knicks began fouling other players to keep the ball away from Chamberlain

questions.prompt: What was Wilt Chamberlain's scoring average over the 1961–62 regular season?
questions.note: 50.4 points per game, a single-season record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain averaged a single-season record 50.4 points per game

funFacts.text: In his first two NBA seasons, Wilt had already averaged 37.6 and 38.4 points per game—before this even more extraordinary season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: having set season scoring records in each of his first two seasons with 37.6 and then 38.4 points per game.

funFacts.text: Warriors coach Frank McGuire opened the season planning to get the ball to Chamberlain roughly two-thirds of the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Frank McGuire, the Warriors' new coach, started the season vowing to get the ball to Chamberlain "two-thirds of the time."

funFacts.text: Wilt entered the famous Knicks game on a tear: he had scored 67, 65, and 61 points in his preceding three games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In three earlier games that week, Chamberlain had scored 67, 65, and 61 points respectively,

questions.prompt: In his 100-point game, how many of his 32 free-throw attempts did Wilt Chamberlain make?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain made … 28 of 32 free throws

funFacts.text: To tackle his free-throw trouble, Wilt had switched to shooting underhanded on his coach's advice that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He had started shooting free throws underhanded that season per McGuire's suggestion.

funFacts.text: Hershey's old, forgiving basket rims may have been a rare advantage for shooters: shots could take a favorable bounce instead of rattling out.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The basket rims at the arena were aged, flimsy, and forgiving.

funFacts.text: Wilt was usually around a 50% free-throw shooter over his career. His accuracy in this game was a remarkable departure.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the latter a far better rate than his roughly 50% career average.

questions.prompt: How many paying spectators watched Wilt Chamberlain's 100-point game?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: only 4,124 spectators paid to see the game

funFacts.text: Before the NBA game, players from the Philadelphia Eagles and Baltimore Colts staged an exhibition basketball game for the crowd.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: players from the Philadelphia Eagles play an exhibition basketball game against their colleagues from the Baltimore Colts

funFacts.text: The Hershey arena could hold more than 8,000 people, so even this historic performance took place before a roughly half-full building.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The arena's capacity was over 8,000

funFacts.text: New York's sportswriters missed the milestone: many were in Florida covering Yankees and expansion Mets spring training.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: reporters were in Florida covering spring training for the New York Yankees and the expansion New York Mets.

questions.prompt: In 1961–62 Wilt played how many total minutes?
questions.note: 3,882, more than 48 a game thanks to overtime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He played in a record 3,882 minutes—including every minute of 79 (a record) of 80 games.

funFacts.text: Wilt scored 4,029 points that season—more than the entire division-winning 1947–48 Warriors team had scored.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He scored a single-season record 4,029 points, more than the division-winning Warriors in 1947–48 scored as a team.

funFacts.text: His average actually exceeded the length of a regulation game: Wilt played 48.5 minutes per night thanks to seven games with overtime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He averaged 48.5 minutes per game. An NBA game is 48 minutes, but Chamberlain played in 10 overtime periods in seven games.

funFacts.text: The remarkable season still ended without a title. Philadelphia lost a seventh playoff game to Boston by just two points, 109–107.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They lost in the Eastern Division Finals of the playoffs to the Celtics, losing the seventh game 109–107.
